risk_note: B2-16d (D10-1228 ②): the console's read-only invite reward endpoints adminListInviteRewards (GET /admin/v1/invite-rewards) and adminGetInviteReward (GET /admin/v1/invite-rewards/{invitee_id}), contract CT-25 series; this PR drops their x-implementation: planned (contract slot granted by the orchestrator 22:22) and regenerates planned-operations.gen.ts and route-schemas.gen.ts. growth reads app.invite_rewards of the console's app only, latest qualified_at first (ties by invitee_id desc), page / page_size, filters invitee_id / inviter_id / status and +08:00 qualified days inclusive (from > to or invalid → 20001); budget from app.invite_reward_budgets (today = +08:00 day by the injected Clock and packages/domain calendar, total row; missing rows 0; independent of filters); amounts passed through as integer fen. Phones masked 3+4 through identity's MaskedPhoneReader injected into a growth port (growth never reads identity tables); no bind_ip_hmac, no voucher ids. fund.view, no step-up; detail without a record → 30701; read only, no audit. Implementer's choice: a non-UUID invitee_id / inviter_id list filter returns an empty page with the budget. Rule tests by an independent Claude in two attempts (r1 spec-test S1: read-only snapshot taken before a login that writes admin.login audit; attempt 2 moves the login first); red 52 for the right reason; Codex spec-test r1 fail → r2 pass. Implementation by Opus 5.5 in one round; container rule tests 52/52 green (4 unit + 48 int). Codex money r1 pass, no findings. No migration. Written by hand.

reviews.note: Codex money r1 pass, no findings

spec_test_review.note: Codex spec-test r1 fail (1 S1: snapshot before login) → r2 pass; tests by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh)

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
